parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization, also known as the enterprise ID. It is a string that can be obtained from the China DevOps URL, for example, https:// devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrgId].

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline. You can obtain it from the pipeline URL, for example, https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/[PipelineId]/current.

parameters.name: relObjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the associated resource. Only variable group IDs are supported.

parameters.name: relObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the associated resource. Only VARIABLE_GROUP is supported.
